purpose: Allow a tentative function hypothesis from whole-domain branch concordance plus FeGP/reaction contexts, without redefining 80% reference-transfer or calibrated_high.
comparators: Every other searched prototype, including alternate-function HmdII and indeterminate Hmd-like proteins, irrespective of their catalytic identity label.
requirements: Complete current prototype search bound to query and reference bank
Nonpartial single-chain Hmd-like domain and complete aligned canonical references, same .8 coverage rule
Every reviewed canonical prototype independently has complete paired coverage and core coverage
Weakest canonical exact-match-per-query-core score exceeds strongest significant alternative score; ties abstain
Existing positive-core and selected canonical winner checks
Independently remapped FeGP ligand/local context for core; His14-like context additionally for H4MPT potential
development_scope: R111 direct-assay diagnostic was inspected before rule design; all panel results are development, no independent credit.
